rules.semantic: A blast's reach is 4 px per owner level clamped to 16..96 px; a 'magical' blast (skip_exit > 0 on the explosion, e.g. a mage-family blast) collapses to the 16-px minimum whatever the level. The finder then searches 15 + range.

arms.observable: range = clamp(4*owner level, 16, 96): L2 -> 16, L10 -> 40, L30 -> 96

rules.anchor: if not self:owner() or self:owner():dead() ~= 0 then
rules.semantic: A bomb (or blast) whose thrower is gone or dead becomes its own owner: it still blows, with its own level for the blast's reach and shove, and no one counts as the owner's ally (its own team gets full damage).

arms.observable: blast.owner == thrower; blast.level = thrower level; allies get half
owner set to the bomb itself; the spawned blast.owner == bomb; reach from the bomb's level; same-team walkers take FULL damage

rules.semantic: A bomb that goes off in a full world still makes its explosion sound and dies, but no blast hurts anyone.

arms.observable: an EXPLOSION fx exists at the bomb's centre, on its floor, with its damage
no explosion entity; SOUND_EXPLODE event still emitted; on_death returns true

rules.semantic: A blast always scorches the tile under its centre (EVENT_DAMAGE_TILE) even when no object is in reach; with nothing in reach it hurts nothing and answers 'not handled'.

arms.observable: EVENT_DAMAGE_TILE at the blast centre emitted; on_death returns false; no hp changes

note: parity: bomb/explosion emission rows byte-compare (event count not a fact for this arm)

rules.condition: w and w:dead()==0 and w:floor()==self:floor() and w:order()~=TREASURE and w:order()~=FX
rules.semantic: A blast shoves and strikes only live walkers, weapons and generators on its own floor: treasure and effects are never blown about, the dead are left alone, and nothing on another floor is touched.

arms.when: live living/weapon/generator on the blast's floor
arms.observable: s_force_command WALK shove away from the centre (min(2+level/15, 8) steps) and attack
untouched: hp and command queue unchanged

rules.semantic: A 'magical' blast (skip_exit > 0) never touches its own owner at all: no shove, no quarter damage.

arms.observable: the owner is shoved and takes a quarter (effect_bomb.lua:79)
owner hp and command queue unchanged

rules.condition: w == owner / owner alive and is_friendly(w) / KIT_NOVA and same team_num / else
rules.semantic: A blast strikes its owner at a quarter of its damage, the owner's living allies at half, and everyone else in full; a SUPERNOVA blast (New Specials, caster already dead) spares its own team colour half instead.

arms.observable: attack at damage/4 (float); blast damage restored after

arms.when: owner alive and friendly to w
blast carries KIT_NOVA and w shares its team_num
